title: Salon appointment reminder
description: Remind clients 24 hours before their salon or spa visit. Appointment reminder WhatsApp template that cuts no-shows. Free to copy and edit.
notes: Send one reminder a day ahead; two feels naggy. Quick replies let clients free up a slot early.
